title: Victorian terrace sash windows, Islington
excerpt: Six original box sash windows re-corded, draught-proofed and re-glazed, keeping every frame.
description: A three-storey terrace with its original 1880s sashes: two painted shut, three with snapped cords and one with a rotten sill. We took the sashes out, replaced cords and parting beads, spliced new timber into the sill, fitted brush draught-proofing throughout and re-glazed two cracked panes.
imageAlt: Front of a white rendered period house with timber windows
body: The owners had been quoted for full replacement by a window company. Every frame was sound apart from one sill, so replacement would have thrown away good joinery and changed the look of the house in a conservation area.
## What we did
- Removed all six sashes, replaced the cords and weights where needed and re-hung them so each opens with one hand.
- Cut out the rotten section of the ground-floor sill and spliced in new timber, primed and ready for decoration.
- Fitted brush draught-proofing into new parting and staff beads on every window.
- Re-glazed two cracked panes with matching glass.
## The result
Six quiet, easy windows that look exactly as they did, with the draughts gone.

title: uPVC windows across a family home, Bromley
excerpt: Nine windows with dropped sashes, failed hinges and three misted units put right in a single visit.
description: A 1990s uPVC installation that had never been serviced. Most windows had dropped on worn friction hinges, two handles had snapped and three sealed units had misted. We replaced hinges in pairs, fitted new handles and gaskets and returned with three new sealed units.
imageAlt: Modern detached house with white framed windows
body: The family had assumed the windows were at the end of their life. The frames were fine; the hardware was simply worn out after twenty-five years.
## What we did
- Measured and replaced the friction hinges on seven casements, in pairs, and re-set each sash.
- Fitted two new espagnolette handles and lubricated the locking gear throughout.
- Renewed the wedge gaskets on the worst four windows.
- Measured three misted units and fitted replacements on the return visit.
## The result
Every window now closes with a light push, locks first time and seals properly.

title: Aluminium windows in an apartment block, Canary Wharf
excerpt: Tilt and turn gearing and hinge repairs across fourteen flats for a managing agent, scheduled floor by floor.
description: The managing agent had a backlog of reports: windows stuck in tilt, handles turning without engaging and two sashes hanging on one hinge. We surveyed every reported window, sourced the correct gearboxes and stays for the system, and completed the repairs over two days with residents notified by floor.
imageAlt: Modern apartment towers with dark aluminium framed windows
body: Tilt and turn windows fail in characteristic ways, and most of the reported faults came down to worn gearboxes and mis-operated sashes.
## What we did
- Surveyed all reported windows in one visit and identified the hardware system.
- Released two sashes hanging on one hinge and re-set them safely.
- Replaced eleven gearboxes and six scissor stays with the correct parts.
- Provided the agent with a per-flat report for their records.
## The result
A cleared backlog, one invoice per flat and no repeat reports in the following quarter.

title: Misted double glazing in a semi-detached house, Harrow
excerpt: Seven failed sealed units replaced within the existing frames, including a large bay.
description: Most windows on the sunny side of the house had misted over two winters. We measured every unit, confirmed glass thickness and spacer sizes, and fitted seven new units including the three that make up the front bay, keeping all the original frames and beads.
imageAlt: House with large glazed windows at dusk
body: The owners had been told the whole bay would need replacing. The frames and hardware were in good order, so only the glass needed attention.
## What we did
- Measured all seven units on the first visit and specified low-emissivity glass to improve on the originals.
- Fitted the new units on fresh packers, cleared the drainage holes and re-fitted the existing beads.
## The result
Clear glass, warmer rooms and the bay exactly as it was from the street.

title: Composite front door and patio door, Wimbledon
excerpt: A front door that had to be lifted to lock and a patio door that had jumped its track, both repaired on one visit.
description: The front door had dropped on its hinges so the multi-point lock no longer met the keeps, and the key had become stiff. The patio slider had worn rollers and had come off its track. We adjusted and replaced hinges, fitted a new cylinder and gearbox, and fitted new rollers to the slider.
imageAlt: Residential building facade with balconies and modern doors
body: ## What we did
- Re-aligned the front door on new flag hinges and replaced the worn gearbox and cylinder, with the cylinder upgraded to a higher-security type.
- Lifted the patio slider, fitted new rollers, cleaned the track and re-set the shoot bolts.
## The result
Both doors lock with one movement and the patio door runs on two fingers.

title: Office window repairs out of hours, Fitzrovia
excerpt: Twenty-two aluminium casements serviced and repaired over two evenings so the office never closed.
description: An occupied office floor where most windows no longer opened or locked. We carried out the work after 6pm over two evenings: replacing handles and locking gear, renewing gaskets, freeing stiff hinges and replacing two cracked units, with the floor fully usable by each morning.
imageAlt: Open-plan office interior with large windows and glass partitions
body: ## What we did
- Surveyed the floor during one lunchtime and agreed an evening schedule with the office manager.
- Replaced fourteen handles and nine locking mechanisms, renewed gaskets on every opening window and freed the stiff hinges.
- Replaced two cracked sealed units on the second evening.
## The result
Every window opens and locks, with no disruption to the working day.
